package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate   = errors.New("invalid telegram update")
	ErrTelegramLinkInvalid     = errors.New("telegram link is invalid or expired")
	ErrTelegramLinkConflict    = errors.New("telegram account is linked to another student")
	ErrTelegramBindingNotFound = errors.New("telegram binding not found")
	ErrTelegramUnavailable     = errors.New("telegram channel unavailable")
	ErrTelegramRejected        = errors.New("telegram delivery rejected")
)

type TelegramLinkCode struct {
	Code      string    `json:"code"`
	BotURL    string    `json:"bot_url"`
	ExpiresAt time.Time `json:"expires_at"`
}

type TelegramLinkRecord struct {
	StudentID         string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	DialogID          string
	ExpiresAt         time.Time
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

type TelegramBinding struct {
	StudentID         string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	DialogID          string
	TelegramUserID    int64
	ChatID            int64
	CreatedAt         time.Time
	UpdatedAt         time.Time
}

func NormalizeTelegramBinding(input TelegramBinding) (TelegramBinding, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) ||
		input.TelegramUserID <= 0 || input.ChatID <= 0 || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return TelegramBinding{}, ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate
	}
	return input, nil
}

type TelegramInboundUpdate struct {
	UpdateID       int64
	TelegramUserID int64
	ChatID         int64
	ChatType       string
	Text           string
	SenderIsBot    bool
}

func NormalizeTelegramInboundUpdate(input TelegramInboundUpdate) (TelegramInboundUpdate, error) {
	input.ChatType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.ChatType))
	if input.UpdateID < 0 || input.TelegramUserID <= 0 || input.ChatID <= 0 || input.ChatType != "private" ||
		input.TelegramUserID != input.ChatID || input.SenderIsBot || !utf8.ValidString(input.Text) ||
		strings.TrimSpace(input.Text) == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Text) > 4096 {
		return TelegramInboundUpdate{}, ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate
	}
	return input, nil
}

type TelegramInboundResult struct {
	Accepted  bool
	ReplyText string
}

type TelegramDelivery struct {
	SourceMessageID string
	StudentID       string
	ChatID          int64
	Body            string
	Status          string
	ClaimToken      string
	Attempts        int
	CreatedAt       time.Time
}
